people.name: Capernaum
people.line: Town in Galilee; center of Jesus' ministry

translations.web: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”
translations.bsb: Then they came to Capernaum. While Jesus was in the house, He asked them, “What were you discussing on the way?”
translations.kjv: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
translations.asv: And they came to Capernaum: and when he was in the house he asked them, What were ye reasoning on the way?
